_meta.source: CDS C9 (GPA distribution) + C21 (ED/EA) via LLM

schools.notes: High school GPA data is not reported. GPAs come in a variety of scales and can be difficult to standardize, especially with international population whose transcripts don't include GPA on a 4-point scale. Early action plan is not offered.
C9 GPA data shows 100% at 3.75-4.00 range and zero for all other ranges; school does not offer Early Action (EA) plans.
GPA distribution data not reported in CDS C9; Early Decision plans reported with ED I and ED II combined totals.
No data on GPA distribution reported (all zeros). Early Decision plan is offered; no Early Action plan.

C9 GPA distribution table shows all zeros, possibly no reported data. Early Decision plan offered with 726 applications and 579 admitted. Early Action is nonbinding with no application/admission counts reported.
GPA distribution not reported in section C9. Early Decision and Early Action data are from section C21-C22.
C9 reports 0% for all GPA ranges, effectively no GPA distribution data provided. C21 reports Early Decision only; no Early Action plans offered.
C9 GPA distribution data not reported (all entries N/A). Early Decision plan is offered with 745 applications and 219 admits. No Early Action plan offered.
